profile.reference: Illustrative xArm 6 base placement: the xarm6-g2-v1 cell-layout tray lands on coffee_pickup; the arm base is 0.7 m above the floor; the AMR body is extruded to 0.6 m, below the arm base plane, and its tray (the cell-layout tray, top 0.76 m) stands on a riser above the body; extruded fixture/AMR heights; not calibrated or physical safety evidence

limitations: mock_kinematic: constant-speed motion on a footprint grid; no dynamics, sensors or hardware collision avoidance.
Venue movement zone serialises robots; parallel granular zones are not enabled for the simulator profile.
Plant goals lost in a crash are reported unknown; mock reconciliation audits only and cannot release them without native proof.
Unresolved asset geometry runs a point model and reports no collision metric.
mock_process coffee cell: illustrative rates/volumes, scalar quantities, no fluid/thermal model; measurements are modelled, not sensed.

mujoco_arm program: the fixture's solved waypoints commanded as quintic-sync-v1 joint trajectories and tracked by a simulated position-controlled xArm 6; dynamics nominal and assumed, not_calibrated; the capsule sweep checks model geometry on the actual joints, with no physical stopping proof.

Arm sweep evidence records motion and scene changes with attachment identity and referenced geometry; identical stationary checks share a tick interval. Evidence is bounded to 4096 intervals; droppedIntervals and armCollisionTraceComplete expose truncation. The first blocked sweep retains its geometry independently.

Arm scene scope: project obstacle rectangles extruded from map z=0, declared illustrative heights, compiled AMR radii, conservative swept AABBs in the declared arm base frame. No calibrated fixture or robot mesh, force, or physical safety validation.
Coffee reconciliation is human-provenance audit only; consumption of an unknown step stays an open stock exception.

mujoco_arm: the arm is a MuJoCo 3.17.0 xArm 6 under position actuators with the fixture's Gripper G2. not_calibrated: masses, inertia, joint limits and forces are the manufacturer's nominal values; gains, friction, contact, pads and the cell layout are assumed. The cup is gripped, lifted and released by contact (the plant reports what the pads hold and where the cup rests); the AMR and the coffee machine are mocks. ARM03 is the swept capsule check on the actual joints every tick, not a physical safety proof.

collision.allowedContactsNote: The allowed pairs are static: each applies over the whole trace (fromTick..toTick), not within a phase. Its phase only names the support it touches (nozzle stand: grasp, tray: release); its revision is the world revision of the run.

notes: Plant: MuJoCo 3.17.0, xArm 6 with Gripper G2 under position actuators; not_calibrated: masses, inertia, limits and forces are manufacturer nominal values, gains, friction, contact, pads and the cell layout assumed.
Release timeout: 200 ticks, an assumed controller value (in neither the spec nor the oracle profile): how long the open gripper waits at the place pose for the cup to rest on the tray.
Sampling: collisions are those the engine reported over every physics substep of a tick (10 x 2 ms); the cups between the pads, the resting state and every pose are read at the end of the tick.

Allowed contacts: the gripper and the held cup may touch the nozzle stand and the tray; the pairs are static for the whole trace (not scoped to a phase). An ARM03 phase only names the support (stand: grasp, tray: release), and its revision is the world revision of the run.
